artworks.title: Foot Combat with Daggers
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor and traces of black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two armored figures embracing. The figures are dressed in antique-looking armor with decorative elements such as feathers and layered skirts. They stand closely, suggesting an embrace or possibly a dance. The armor is detailed with metallic hues and intricate designs. Overall, the composition is centered, with ample negative space around the figures, emphasizing their presence and interaction.

artworks.title: Foot Combat with Daggers
artworks.medium: pen and black ink with watercolor over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of two skeletons in armor engaged in a combat-like interaction. The artwork features two skeletal figures, each clad in stylized armor. They face each other, locked in a dance or duel. The figure on the left wields a short sword in one hand. The scene is rendered in hues of blue and brown, giving it an antique feel. The background is a neutral off-white. The skeletal theme, paired with period-style garments, conveys historical intrigue and macabre humor. This is in style of Hieronymus Bosch.

artworks.title: Portrait of Madame Delâtre
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint [proof], printed in red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Purchased for the Virginia and Ira Jackson Collection
artworks.description: The image displays a person's side profile, focusing on their head and shoulders. The person has a slightly bowed head and downward gaze. Their facial features include a well-defined nose and lips, with downward eyes, and curly, voluminous hair styled up. The clothing drapes over their shoulders. The background features intricate, closely spaced lines for texture, without identifiable elements.

artworks.title: Village Overlooking a Bay
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape with a horizon higher up in the composition, showcasing distant mountains, a castle-like structure, a winding path, trees, vegetation, and a building in the distance. The intricate brushstrokes resemble etching techniques, creating texture and shading. The color palette is black and white, with varying densities of hatching and cross-hatching providing a range of greys and shadows.

artworks.title: Allegory on the Recovery of the King
artworks.creditLine: Gift of James A. Bergquist in honor of Dwayne and Faith Perry
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an allegorical scene with classical figures. The central figure is seated on a pedestal, wearing a regal robe and crowned by a standing figure. The pedestal has the inscription "REDENTI SATVRNIA REGNA" and is flanked by two cherubic figures, one holding a cornucopia. To each side, a robed female figure stands on a pedestal, one holding an olive branch and the other holding a bouquet of flowers. Each figure is framed within a niche, creating a sense of architectural depth. The scene is detailed, capturing the grandeur and symbolism typical of neoclassical art, with elements such as drapery, architectural structures, and textures adding to the composition.

artworks.title: Confirmation
artworks.medium: brown wash and white gouache over black chalk on laid paper, laid down on an old album sheet
artworks.creditLine: Purchased as the Gift of Ivan E. and Winifred Phillips in memory of Neil Phillips
artworks.description: This is a painting of a group of people gathered in an interior setting during what appears to be a significant event or ceremony. This is in the style of Giovanni Battista Piazzetta. The scene is filled with figures clothed in flowing robes, some standing while others are seated. The focal point of the image is a central figure seated on an ornate chair, appearing to hold an attentive posture toward another figure kneeling in front of them. The background reveals multiple figures that seem to be gathered around a table covered with a cloth, featuring vases and a large basin. The use of light and shadow directs attention across different parts of the painting, illuminating some figures while casting others in shadow, creating a sense of depth and focus in the composition. The warm tones of browns and whites hint at a somber or contemplative atmosphere that draws viewers into the unfolding event.

artworks.title: The South-East View of Brough-Castle, in the County of Westmorland
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother, Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image shows a detailed engraving of the southeast view of Wardour Castle. The castle's facade is prominent, with hills and clouds in the background. The engraving depicts the intricate architecture of the castle, including battlements with vegetation. The style is detailed with fine lines, creating a three-dimensional effect. The color scheme is mainly monochrome using black, white, and shades of gray. The courtyard and gardens are accurately detailed, enclosed by stone walls with trees and pathways.

artworks.title: The South-East View of Wardour Castle, in the County of Wilts
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Vogler in memory of his brother, Donald J. Vogler
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed illustration of Brough Castle from a southeast perspective in the county of Westmorland. The castle stands centrally, with tall, rectangular towers and partially intact walls. The horizon is positioned high, aligning with the castle's tallest points, with rolling hills in the background. The technique used is stippling and linear hatching, creating a textured effect. The color palette is mainly monochromatic, typical of traditional line engravings, enhancing contrasts between light and shadow. In the foreground, there is a grassy hill with low shrubs and rocks. Beyond the castle, the landscape slopes towards distant hills under light clouds. The composition elegantly combines architectural and natural elements within the framed scene.

artworks.title: The Scourged Back
artworks.description: This sepia-toned photograph shows the upper half of a man who is seated with his back towards us. The man's head is turned over his left shoulder, allowing us to see his face in profile. He is topless, with dark skin, short, curly hair, and a beard. He sits on a stool with fabric wrapped around his waist and his left hand on his hip. His bare back is covered in overlapping scars that stretch from the bottom of his neck to his hips. The scars are raised and reflect light from an unseen light source. The background is a plain, tan surface, and the photograph is framed by a thin red outline.

artworks.title: "Regular Contraband"
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated man with his legs crossed on a wooden chair. He has a focused expression, prominent facial features, and short hair. The man wears a cap, a tattered jacket, a worn-out shirt, and pants with tears. The chair is simple, and the background is plain with light-colored fabric.

artworks.title: “Christopher Anderson, Priv. Co. F. 108 U.S.C.T.”
artworks.description: The image shows a man in a military uniform standing upright with a neutral expression. He has short, curly hair, a mustache, and a short beard. He is wearing a buttoned coat, light-colored trousers, and a peaked cap. A belt with a circular buckle and a strap is diagonally across his chest. He is holding a rifle pointed upward in his right hand. The background is plain with a light-colored backdrop and a simple floor.

artworks.title: Isaac and Rosa, Emancipated Slave Children, from the Free Schools of Louisiana
Our Protection. Rosa, Charley, Rebecca. Slave Children from New Orleans.
artworks.description: The image is a group portrait of three children named Rosa, Charley, and Rebecca. They are sitting closely together and captured from the upper body up. Charley is seated slightly higher than the other two. Rosa has curly hair, Charley has short straight hair, and Rebecca has smooth straight hair. They are draped in fabric resembling the American flag, covering most of their outfits. The background is a plain, neutral-toned canvas.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Woman
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman standing and facing slightly to her right. She has a warm expression, with her eyes and lips partially visible. Her hair is covered with a light-colored headscarf. She is wearing a dark long-sleeved dress with a high collar and white lace or ruffled collar. The dress has a fitted bodice with buttons down the front, and lace or ruffles on the cuffs. She is holding a white teacup on a saucer in one hand, with a cloth napkin on her wrist. Beside her is an ornate side table. The background is plain with subtle detailing at the base and tiled flooring.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man
artworks.description: The image displays a man standing next to a large, white column. He is leaning slightly against the column with one hand resting on it, while his other hand holds a hat at his side. He has a calm expression, a slight mustache, and short neatly kept hair. He is dressed in formal attire, including a dark long coat, a light-colored waistcoat, checked trousers, and polished shoes. The background shows a painted landscape with trees, possibly a stream or path.

artworks.title: Portrait of a Man and Woman
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Harris, in memory of Shirlee A. Harris
artworks.description: The image shows a seated couple. The woman is on the left, facing the man, with her hands on her lap. She wears a long, striped dress and has styled hair. The man sits on the right with his legs crossed. He has a beard and mustache, and wears a dark suit with a waistcoat. They sit on vintage chairs against a textured backdrop, with a tiled floor.

artworks.title: United States Capitol
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Thomas Harris, in memory of Shirlee A. Harris
artworks.description: This is a photograph of a neoclassical building under construction. The image shows a symmetrically designed building with two round structures or wings in the process of being worked on, evident from the scaffolding and construction equipment visible on top. The building features classical architectural elements, including a colonnade with Corinthian columns supporting a pediment adorned with sculptural details. In front of the building, there is a row of trees and a lawn. The photograph has a vintage quality, likely owing to its age.

artworks.title: Mary Todd Lincoln
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the midriff up, with neatly styled hair adorned with flowers. She has a composed expression, wearing an elaborate dress with lace bodice and draped sleeves. Accessories include a bracelet, pearls, and earrings. She holds a small bouquet of flowers close to her chest. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Laura Keene
artworks.description: The image shows a woman in a seated position from the waist up. She is positioned slightly to the side, with her body turned slightly to her right while her head is facing forward. The woman has distinct facial features with arched eyebrows and a subtle expression. Her hair is dark and styled in soft, voluminous curls that frame her face. She is wearing a dark, formal dress with elaborate detailing; the bodice features decorative buttons and patterned fabric panels, while the sleeves and skirt have ornate trim. Over the dress, she wears gloves that reach to her elbows and appear to be made of a shiny material. In her right hand, she holds an object below her eye level, partially visible due to the position of her arm. The background is plain and neutral, drawing focus to the woman in the foreground.

artworks.title: Booth and his Associates
artworks.description: The image is a composite of seven portrait photographs. Each shows the head and upper part of the torso of different individuals against a plain, textured background. In the center is a slightly larger image labeled "BOOTH." Clockwise from the top left, the other labeled portraits are "HEROLD," "ATZERODT," "SPANGLER," "O'LAUGHLIN," "PAYNE," and "ARNOLD." Each man varies in facial hair styles and haircuts, with some appearing clean-shaven while others have beards or mustaches. Their attire is typical of the late 19th century, featuring high-collared shirts and ties or cravats, with some wearing hats. The photos are in rectangular frames assembled on a beige background, labeled "BOOTH AND HIS ASSOCIATES" at the bottom in capital letters.

artworks.title: General Joseph Hooker
artworks.description: The image shows a male figure seated on a foldable wooden chair in a side-profile position, wearing a full military uniform. He has sharp facial features, light hair, and a composed expression. He is wearing polished boots, and a sword with a decorative hilt is beside him. A draped flag with stars is hanging on his right. There is a textured carpet beneath his feet, and the background is a plain wall.

artworks.title: General George Armstrong Custer
artworks.description: The image shows a man from the waist up, seated and slightly turned to the side. He has prominent facial features with a strong jawline and a mustache. His hair is long and wavy, extending past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark military uniform with buttons and a light necktie. On his shoulders, he has insignias. He is also wearing a wide-brimmed hat with a pin on the front. The background is a neutral tone.
